ex.en: The proliferation of Internet usage has given birth to a new generation of young people.
ex.zh: 網路使用的普及造就了新一代的年輕人。

ex.en: Our data usage has doubled this year.
ex.zh: 我們今年的數據用量增加了一倍。

ex.en: Water usage is higher in summer.
ex.zh: 夏天的用水量比較高。

ex.en: This dictionary explains the usage of common words.
ex.zh: 這本字典解說常用字的用法。

ex.en: This expression is common in American usage.
ex.zh: 這個說法在美式用法中很常見。

ex.en: Man is the only animal that uses fire.
ex.zh: 人類是唯一會使用火的動物。

ex.en: Can I use your phone?
ex.zh: 我可以借用你的手機嗎？

ex.en: The information you gave me is of little use.
ex.zh: 你給我的資訊沒什麼用。

ex.en: It is no use arguing with him about it.
ex.zh: 跟他爭論這件事沒有用。

use.zh: used to：以前常常、過去曾經

ex.en: Tom never used to smoke, but he does now.
ex.zh: 湯姆以前從不抽菸，但現在會抽了。

ex.en: I used to live in Tainan.
ex.zh: 我以前住在台南。

ex.en: You will soon get used to speaking in public.
ex.zh: 你很快就會習慣在公開場合說話。

ex.en: I'm used to getting up early.
ex.zh: 我習慣早起。

ex.en: A passport is usually necessary when you travel overseas.
ex.zh: 出國旅行通常需要護照。

ex.en: What do you usually do in your free time?
ex.zh: 你空閒時通常做什麼？

ex.en: I usually don't get up until noon on Sundays.
ex.zh: 我星期天通常到中午才起床。

ex.en: An uncle of mine gave me some useful advice.
ex.zh: 我的一位叔叔給了我一些有用的建議。

ex.en: This book may well be useful to you.
ex.zh: 這本書可能對你很有用。

ex.en: This book will be very useful to us.
ex.zh: 這本書對我們會非常有用。

ex.en: With this upgrade, one obvious impact is that users will be obliged to reset their passwords.
ex.zh: 這次升級一個明顯的影響是使用者必須重設密碼。

ex.en: This app attracts over 10,000 users each day who engage with its features.
ex.zh: 這個 App 每天吸引超過一萬名使用者使用它的功能。

ex.en: If only I read the user manual properly.
ex.zh: 要是我當初有好好看使用手冊就好了。

ex.en: You cannot solve this problem with the usual method.
ex.zh: 這個問題沒辦法用平常的方法解決。

ex.en: Tom is dressed a little more casually than usual.
ex.zh: 湯姆今天穿得比平常隨便一點。

ex.en: He put the key on the desk as usual.
ex.zh: 他和平常一樣把鑰匙放在書桌上。

ex.en: As usual, he placed the key on the table.
ex.zh: 他一如往常地把鑰匙放在桌上。
